mapper.select: SELECT a.*, pa.name as payment_account_name, pa.balance as payment_account_balance, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON a.payment_account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON a.contract_id = sc.id WHERE a.account_id = #{id}

SELECT MONTH(transaction_date) AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS income, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'expense' THEN amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS expense FROM accounts WHERE YEAR(transaction_date) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(transaction_date) ORDER BY month
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts (project_id, transaction_date, amount, type, receipt_id, payment_account_id, contract_id, payment_type, allocation_status, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{transactionDate}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{receiptId}, #{paymentAccountId}, #{contractId}, #{paymentType}, #{allocationStatus}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET project_id = #{projectId}, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, amount = #{amount}, type = #{type}, receipt_id = #{receiptId}, payment_account_id = #{paymentAccountId}, contract_id = #{contractId}, payment_type = #{paymentType}, allocation_status = #{allocationStatus}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, pa.name as payment_account_name, pa.balance as payment_account_balance, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON a.payment_account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON a.contract_id = sc.id WHERE a.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT a.*, pa.name as payment_account_name, pa.balance as payment_account_balance, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON a.payment_account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON a.contract_id = sc.id WHERE a.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.payment_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pa.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sc.contract_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY a.transaction_date DESC
